metric_definitions.full_2D_grid: Unmasked complete [y,x] domain; relative L2=norm(model-PIC)/norm(PIC), relative L1=sum(abs(model-PIC))/sum(abs(PIC)). Uniform cell-area factors cancel.
metric_definitions.x_averaged_profile: First arithmetic x mean at each y, then one-dimensional L1/L2 errors. These are separate projected diagnostics and may cancel x structure.
metric_definitions.zero_denominator: Null relative error, with an explicit reason; no epsilon denominator or favorable ROI.
metric_definitions.time: Actual available output times retained, with offsets; no time interpolation or exact-t=300 substitution.

PIC_reference.moment_semantics: vfl is documented ordinary population mean; second diagnostics are documented unnormalized raw moments. Third-diagnostic normalization is unverified.
PIC_reference.conditional_qxxx_definition: Assuming unnormalized third diagnostics: sum_s v1v1v1_s-3*u_x*Mxx+2*rho*u_x^3, unit electron mass; arithmetic validation is not normalization validation.

tagged_qCS_interpretation.definition: sum_s[3*(u_sx-u_x)*P_sxx+n_s*(u_sx-u_x)^3]; exact vacuum contributes zero without a density floor or pressure clamping.
tagged_qCS_interpretation.population_decomposition: Actual deposited PIC tag1/tag2 first and second moments, not a synthetic split of the aggregate.

tagged_qCS_interpretation.qualification: The algebraic qCS reference uses documented first/second diagnostics. Small negative recovered tagged covariance values are retained without clipping and do not pass strict nonnegativity; this diagnostic comparison is not a physical-state conformance certificate or a full heat-flux comparison.

central_qxxx_interpretation.assumption: The v1v1v1 population diagnostics are unnormalized raw third moments.
central_qxxx_interpretation.qualification: The deposit explicitly defines first/second diagnostics, but third HDF5 LABEL/UNITS do not distinguish normalization and the exact custom implementation is unavailable. Every comparison using exported central qxxx is conditional; density/current/pressure are unaffected.

counter_streaming_qualification: qCSxxx is only a population-recentering contribution, not unique full fluid heat flux under a local-divergence closure. Its separate comparison to the actual tagged PIC qCS uses documented first/second moments, with negative tagged covariance diagnostics retained explicitly. Exported PIC central qxxx additionally assumes unverified unnormalized third diagnostics, so that target's comparisons are conditional. One-population zero contributions are omitted.
